reason: A runtime integration plugin that connects Multica with DeepSeek Harness through a JSONL stdio bridge, supporting model discovery, event streaming, session resume, cancellation, and MCP client configuration.

summaries.zh: 连接 Multica 与 DeepSeek Harness 运行时，提供模型发现、事件流、会话恢复、取消控制和 MCP 配置转换。
summaries.en: Connects Multica with the DeepSeek Harness runtime for model discovery, event streaming, session resume, cancellation, and MCP configuration translation.

capabilities: Bridges Multica to the DeepSeek Harness runtime over a versioned JSONL stdio protocol
Discovers models and thinking levels from the connected runtime
Streams text, reasoning, tool, result, and token-usage events
Supports cooperative cancellation and durable session resume
Translates Multica MCP configuration to DSH stdio or streamable-HTTP clients
Forwards a server-minted task token into the runtime shell
